transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I know what I see. I know they've been watching my moves at work, and... they keep changing the pallet counts on me just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you been hearing voices that other people do not hear?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes when I'm working down in the aisle, or... even just folding clothes at home, I hear a man's voice. It's clear as day. He says, Nicole, check it again. But I look around and there is nobody near me when it happens.
Have you had a period of several days or more when you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, I have. There have been weeks, actually, where I sleep... maybe three hours a night. I'll just wake up way before my alarm even goes off, and I just feel like I don't need any more rest to get moving. I just get right up and go.
Have you ever had a time when the voices or beliefs were present even when you were not feeling unusually energized or down?

Yeah, that happens. There was a time, maybe a few weeks, where I was actually sleeping closer to normal. I wasn't racing around or feeling all that energized. But even then... I still heard that man's voice telling me to check things. And I still knew they were messing with my pallet counts. It didn't stop just because I was getting more sleep.
Have you ever had at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or having the suspicious beliefs even though you were not having a manic or depressed episode?

Yeah, like I was just saying, that did happen for a few weeks. It was a quieter time for me... I was sleeping closer to normal and I wasn't racing around as much. But even during those couple of weeks, I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still knew they were changing the pallet counts against me. So, yeah, the voices and all that were still there even when my sleep was fine.
Have these voices or beliefs been going on for more than six months?
Yeah, it's been longer than six months. I'd say... the voices and that feeling that people are watching me or changing things around, it's been happening for about eight months now.
Have you had a period of at least one week when you felt unusually high or irritable and had a lot more energy than usual?

Yeah, I definitely have times like that. There are some days where I just feel totally fired up, like nobody can slow me down and I have all this energy. But then... if my husband just asks one small question, like about the kids or what my schedule is for the day, I just snap at him. I get so irritated, like he's trying to control me or something. So yeah, I get really high energy, but also really irritable.
When the voices or suspicious beliefs are happening, do they ever continue for at least two weeks when you are not having any manic or depressive symptoms?

Yeah, like I mentioned a couple minutes ago, that's exactly what happened. I had a few weeks where things felt a lot quieter. I wasn't racing around, and I was actually sleeping pretty close to normal. But even during that time, I still heard the voice telling me to check things, and I still knew for a fact they were messing with the pallet counts against me. So, yeah, it definitely continues even when my mood is fine.
Have you had a time when you felt depressed or down for at least two weeks?

No, I don't really get like that. I haven't had any times where I just felt down or sad for weeks at a time. It's mostly just the high energy and the irritability, and then the voices and the stuff at work. But not really depressed, no.
Have these voices or beliefs ever gone away completely for a while, or have they been present pretty much continuously since they started?

No, they haven't really gone away completely. The voices and... just that feeling that people are watching me or changing things around, it's been happening pretty much continuously for about eight months now.
Did the voices or suspicious beliefs start before you ever had the high-energy or irritable periods?

Yeah, they did. Like I said, the voices and feeling like people are messing with my stuff started about eight months ago. But those stretches where I feel really wired, where I sleep very little and end up taking on way too much... those have only been coming and going for about six months. So, yeah, the voices definitely started before the high energy kicked in.
Have you had times when your thoughts felt very jumbled or hard to follow, or other people said your speech didn't make sense?

Yeah, that happens. When I try to explain what's going on, my words just kind of run all over the place. Like, I'll start talking about the forklift sheets at work, and then jump straight to the church signs I saw, and then to my husband's tone of voice. People have told me they just can't follow what I'm saying. It makes sense in my head, but when I try to get it out, they say it doesn't make any sense.
Since all of this started, has it caused a big drop in your work, home, or social functioning?

Yeah, it definitely has. At work, my supervisors actually took me off the forklift and some of the other safety-sensitive stuff. They said my counts were off and I was just slowing the whole line down. And... well, at home, it's not much better. My husband tells me he just can't rely on me the way he used to. So, yeah, it's definitely affecting things.
Have there been times when your voices or beliefs were still present even when you were not having any high-energy or irritable mood symptoms?

Yeah. Like... I had a quieter few weeks a little while back where I was actually sleeping closer to normal. I wasn't racing around as much or getting all worked up. But even during that time, I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still fully believed that my pallet counts were being changed against me at work. So, yeah, that stuff is still there even when my energy isn't all high and wired.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the voices or beliefs were present, but you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

Yeah, like I was just saying, that quieter time I had lasted for a few weeks. It was definitely at least two weeks where I was sleeping pretty close to normal and not racing around. But the whole time, I still heard that voice telling me to check things, and I still believed they were changing my pallet counts on me. So, yeah, it was for sure two weeks.
